leaves.label: Save waits until a dose is set, and no Adjust row shows before a dosage

gwt.given: A worker recording a treatment for two pigs has picked the medicine but typed no dosage.
gwt.when: They look at the form.
gwt.then: Save is waiting, and there is no row offering to adjust the doses.

authority.says: Save waits until the shared dose is set, or every included pig has a typed dose.
no dosage, no row

leaves.label: One dosage applies to every pig: one row says so and offers Adjust; Save counts the pigs

gwt.given: A worker is recording a treatment for two pigs.
gwt.when: They type a dosage of 2.5.
gwt.then: A row reads 2 pigs at 2.5 mL each with Adjust, and Save is ready for both pigs.

authority.says: Once a dosage is typed, one navigate row under it reads "2 pigs · 2.5 mL each" with "Adjust ›"

leaves.label: A pig's own dose is kept and the form counts it as adjusted

gwt.given: A worker set a dosage of 2.5 for two pigs.
gwt.when: On Dose per pig they give one pig 3 and go back.
gwt.then: The form's row reads 2 pigs with 1 adjusted, and Save is still ready for both.

authority.says: typing a different value makes it that pig's own … (after changes: "2 pigs · 1 adjusted")
Treatment never implies identical doses across pigs.

leaves.label: Removing a pig takes it out of the treatment; the last pig cannot be removed

gwt.given: A worker is recording a treatment for two pigs with a dosage set.
gwt.when: On Dose per pig they remove one pig and go back.
gwt.then: Remove mode ends with one pig left, and the form saves the treatment for one pig.

authority.says: Remove pigs … switches the list into remove mode … the last pig cannot be removed.

leaves.label: Saving lands on the walk list, where a toast says what was recorded and for how many pigs

gwt.given: A worker has set a dosage for two pigs on Record treatment.
gwt.when: They tap Save.
gwt.then: The form closes onto the walk list and a message says the treatment was recorded for 2 pigs.

authority.says: The result is not visible: a Toast, what was done and for whom

leaves.label: The treatment draft survives leaving the form and reopening it

gwt.given: A worker has picked Tulathromycin and typed a dosage of 2.5 for two pigs.
gwt.when: They go Back out of the form and open Record treatment again for the same pigs.
gwt.then: The form still has Tulathromycin and the 2.5 dosage.

authority.says: Footer Back keeps the draft

leaves.label: One tap picks the medicine and closes the picker onto the form, with its withdrawal caption

gwt.given: A worker is recording a treatment and has opened Antibiotics in the medicine picker.
gwt.when: They tap Amoxicillin.
gwt.then: The picker closes, Medicine reads Amoxicillin, and a caption under it gives its 14-day withdrawal and the date it ends.

authority.says: a category: its medicines; one tap picks and closes
a muted caption in the field's hint slot reads "Withdrawal period 14 days · until 26 Sep"

leaves.label: Footer Back in a category goes up to the picker's first level, not out of the drawer

gwt.given: A worker has opened Antibiotics in the medicine picker.
gwt.when: They tap Back in the footer.
gwt.then: The picker shows its first level again, with the recent medicines and the categories, and the drawer stays open.

authority.at: Rules: the picker is one drawer with levels
authority.says: the footer Back goes up a level, the ✕ at the top left closes it from any level

leaves.label: ✕ closes the whole picker from a level, leaving Medicine unset

gwt.given: A worker has opened Antibiotics in the medicine picker without picking.
gwt.when: They tap ✕ at the top left.
gwt.then: The whole picker closes onto the form and Medicine is still not chosen.

authority.at: Rules: the picker is one drawer with levels
authority.says: the ✕ at the top left closes it from any level

leaves.label: The medicine's last method and unit fill the form

gwt.given: The farm last gave Meloxicam by injection in mL.
gwt.when: A worker picks Meloxicam for a new treatment.
gwt.then: Method reads Injection and the dose unit reads mL without the worker setting them.

authority.says: The treatment remembers the last method and unit per medicine and pre-fills them.

leaves.label: A medicine with no brands yet says how to add one, and typing a name adds it

gwt.given: The farm has never recorded a brand for Ceftiofur.
gwt.when: A worker opens Brand for it, types the name on the bottle and adds it.
gwt.then: The empty list first says there are no brands yet and to type a name; after adding, the form's Brand reads the new name.

authority.says: A search with no match shows one card, Add “…”, which adds the brand under that medicine for everyone and picks it
Shown only when the medicine has no brands and nothing is typed. It names the medicine; the search above is the way to add

leaves.label: A search result names its category, because search mixes categories

gwt.given: A worker has the medicine picker open.
gwt.when: They type part of a medicine's name.
gwt.then: The matching medicine is listed with its category under it, and the categories list is gone.

authority.says: a search result names its category, because search mixes categories

leaves.label: A tap on the waiting Add marks the empty Category Required

gwt.given: A worker is adding a medicine named from their search and has not chosen its category.
gwt.when: They tap Add.
gwt.then: Nothing is added; Category is marked Required and the add level stays open.

authority.says: Waits until Name and Category are set; a tap while waiting marks them Required.
Category (required, one pick)

leaves.why: The runner refuses to tap a waiting (aria-disabled) control as unreachable, but a worker can tap it: the leaf needs a step that taps a waiting control. Covered meanwhile by ux/system/medicines.test.cjs.

leaves.label: Adding lists the medicine and picks it: the drawer closes on the form

gwt.given: A worker has named a missing medicine Cefquinome and chosen Antibiotics.
gwt.when: They tap Add.
gwt.then: The picker closes and the treatment's Medicine reads Cefquinome.

authority.says: Adding lists it for everyone and picks it.

leaves.label: Back from the add level keeps its draft: the category chosen is still there

gwt.given: A worker adding Cefquinome has chosen Antibiotics as its category.
gwt.when: They go Back to the search and tap the same Add card again.
gwt.then: The add level reopens with Antibiotics still chosen.

authority.says: Footer Back keeps the draft; in a drawer with levels it goes up one level

leaves.label: A brand with its own withdrawal shows it under Brand

gwt.given: Amoxinsol 50% has its own 2-day withdrawal, unlike Amoxicillin's 14 days.
gwt.when: A worker picks that brand on the treatment.
gwt.then: Brand reads Amoxinsol 50% and the caption under it gives its 2-day withdrawal.

authority.says: A brand overrides it only when its label differs.
under Brand when the chosen brand has its own period

leaves.label: The new brand's details are optional: Add with the field empty keeps the medicine's period

gwt.given: A worker has added a new brand, Moxylan, from the brand search.
gwt.when: They tap Add on its details without typing a withdrawal.
gwt.then: The form shows Brand Moxylan, and the caption under Medicine still gives Amoxicillin's 14 days.

authority.says: then offers an optional, skippable details step (its withdrawal)
Withdrawal period (days), never required.

leaves.label: A vaccination lists vaccines by disease at once, under a label that is not the title

gwt.given: A worker is recording a vaccination.
gwt.when: They open the vaccine picker.
gwt.then: It lists vaccines by disease straight away, recent ones then All, with no medicines and no category level.

authority.says: Record vaccination uses the same picker filtered to Vaccines.
Vaccines are named by the disease (PRRS, PCV2…), so a vaccination lists diseases.

leaves.label: A starting-list medicine edits only its default withdrawal: no name field, no Delete

gwt.given: The farm's list includes Amoxicillin from the starting list.
gwt.when: The supervisor opens it on the Medicines page.
gwt.then: Only its default withdrawal can be edited; its name is the title and there is no Delete.

authority.says: a starting-list medicine: its default withdrawal only, its name read-only … Starting-list medicines have no Delete.

leaves.label: Back keeps a brand's unsaved edit when it is reopened

gwt.given: The supervisor typed a new name for the brand Clamoxyl but did not save.
gwt.when: They go Back to Amoxicillin and open Clamoxyl again.
gwt.then: The name field still holds what they typed.

authority.says: Footer Back keeps the draft; in a drawer with levels it goes up one level

leaves.label: Deleting a farm-added medicine takes it off the list after a confirm level

gwt.given: The farm added Gamithromycin itself.
gwt.when: The supervisor opens it, taps Delete medicine and confirms.
gwt.then: The confirm says past records keep its name, and Gamithromycin is gone from Antibiotics.

authority.says: Delete as a navigate Row in its own card at the bottom, opening a confirm level ("Past records keep its name") … Delete removes the entry from the picker
